quotes.text: Simulates subjective patient reporting in lay language
each powered by GPT-5.4-mini and restricted to a designated readview

parsed.rationale: The paper discloses that the patient, nurse, lab and history tools are served by LLM agents (GPT-5.4-mini) over restricted readviews. No tests or conformance checks of tool behavior are reported. The tool descriptions and system prompt shown to the agent do not say the responders are simulated.
